title: Florida AI Laws

reading.body:
Florida has enacted exactly one AI-related law, S1816, which designates CyberBay in the Tampa Bay area as a cybersecurity and artificial intelligence innovation region.

Passed on March 12, 2026, S1816 is a recognition rather than a regulation. It acknowledges Florida's national leadership in cybersecurity preparedness and digital defense, and it affirms the importance of continued public-private collaboration to strengthen cyber readiness and economic resilience. It imposes no obligations on any party.

The law does not mention compute, data centers, power, or grid capacity. It therefore offers no direct evidence about AI infrastructure constraints in Florida. What it shows is a state using legislative language to designate a region for AI and cybersecurity, not to govern AI systems or fund physical capacity.
